name: Paper and own registers
description: Agencies that keep their registries and books on paper, in spreadsheets or in their own software. Payment orders go to the bank on paper, or through eMDS where the sub-account is at the Land Bank.
note: The Manual prescribes forms, not systems. Which agencies belong here is not stated.

name: COA eBudget and eNGAS
description: Agencies that keep their registries of allotments and obligations in the eBudget of COA and their books in eNGAS. Payment orders as in cohort P.
note: How many agencies use these systems is not stated.

name: BTMS
description: Agencies in the BTMS rollout: obligation requests, purchase orders, goods received notes, vouchers, payments and journal entries are records in one system, and payments go by electronic transfer (PESONet, InstaPay) or check.
note: The number of agencies in this cohort is uncertain (gap GAP-BTMS-SCALE).
